goal: Generate a 3:4 vertical founder environmental portrait suitable for the opening or header image of a technology and finance media feature, recognizable as the public image of American entrepreneur Elon Musk, with a strong narrative quality, serious tone, not caricatured or exaggerated style.

subject.identity: 航天与智能电动车领域连续创业者、上市公司高管
subject.appearance: Short or slightly curly short hair, can have light short beard, natural warm skin tone but slightly subdued in cool-toned environments
subject.outfit: Black or charcoal gray t-shirt or turtleneck knit, layered with unbuttoned dark short jacket, no visible large brand logo

composition.shot: 腰上环境人像，人物占垂直方向约 60%
composition.framing: Character beside a pillar in the left 1/3 of the frame, with the right 2/3 showing a blurred view of the city nightscape or factory outlines through a glass window.
composition.title_safe_area: Top right 25% area to remain clean dark color or low texture, reserved for Chinese title and English subtitle; character's gaze to the right can guide reading

environment.location: High ceiling modern office space, weak floor reflectivity, silhouettes of long table and single chairs in the distance, not imitating any recognizable decor of famous headquarters
environment.depth: f/2.0 shallow depth of field, window pane lines softened into geometric light bands

lighting.style: Large window side light + weak indoor ceiling light, overall low-key.
lighting.key_light: 自画面左侧大窗入射的冷白日光或蓝白城市反射光，人物面颊主亮区清晰
lighting.fill_light: Opposite deep gray wall reflects about 0.2 compared to fill light, retaining jacket texture
lighting.color_temp: Main light slightly cool 6000-6500K, skin tone in post-processing allowed to slightly warm 200K only to natural

expression.mood: Contemplative, with a hint of looking forward, lips slightly tight in a neutral expression.
expression.gaze: gaze slightly towards the upper right outside the frame, aligned with the title safe zone, not looking directly at the center of the lens

style.rendering: Magazine-level portrait sharpness, printable and scalable
style.tone: Dark areas not crushed, highlight window edge slightly rolled off, with slight film grain 8-12% that does not pixelate the skin
style.color_palette: Cool gray + ink black + warm mid-tone of the illuminated side skin color

must_keep: The direction of light is self-consistent, shadows at the window and facial transitions are consistent
Top right and publication header reading path without cluttered props exposure
No overlapping corporate logos with car logos
avoid: Strong Contour Lights Create Stage Makeup Effect
Readable SpaceX or Tesla real logo in the background
